coverage.M2L6-E03: construct and query a list of dictionaries
coverage.M2L6-E04: trace dictionary mutations and explain methods
coverage.M2L6-E05: calculate and apply thresholds to dictionary records
coverage.M2L6-E06: analyze dictionary data using maximum and filtering
coverage.M2L6-E07: debug and repair a dictionary frequency program
coverage.M2L6-E08: calculate elasticity and critically evaluate a classification rule
